title: Cosmic Egg Guardian
description: A surreal central creature with large black eyes and multiple smaller eyes holds a pale egg while surrounded by floating planets, feathers, and esoteric symbols. A translucent human profile appears on the right, facing the entity within a swirling vortex of cosmic patterns and mystical iconography.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a strange grey-skinned creature with enormous black eyes and smaller eyes on stalks, wearing a green floral eye mask, holding a large pale egg. Floating around it are Earth-like planets, ancient runes, feathers, and mystical symbols. A translucent human side profile emerges from the right side of the frame. Swirling vortex of purple, teal and gold with intricate esoteric patterns filling the background.
